date_text: Fri, Oct 23rd • 12:00 PM AEDT - Fri, Oct 23rd • 11:00 PM AEDT
description: Including Night 8 of the Sweeneys Beer Week Olympics 2026 - Coaster Flip Challenge, Cash Prize and Finalist Sunday BIG Prize! The crew from Aether Brewing are heading down from Queensland and they’re not coming empty-handed. They’ve been busy collaborating with breweries from all around Australia, creating a lineup of special, one-off collaboration beers — and on Friday night, they’re bringing the lot to Hotel Sweeney’s rooftop. Never-before-seen beers. One rooftop. The Aether lads in the house. And because this is Sweeney’s during Beer Week, obviously we’re turning it into a competition. 🍺 AETHER & FRIENDS – COLLABORATION TAP TAKEOVER Aether are bringing the goods, with a stack of one-off collaboration beers created with breweries from around Australia, all pouring across the Sweeney’s rooftop taps. The Aether crew will be there to talk beer, have a yarn, spin the chocolate wheel and enjoy the Friday night chaos. 🃏 THE CLASSIC SWEENEY’S COASTER FLIP It’s another night of the Sweeney’s Beer Week Olympics, and Friday brings back an absolute classic. The rules? Start with ONE coaster. Place it on the edge of the table. Flick it into the air with the back of your hand. Catch it before it hits the table. Got it? Add another. One becomes two. Two becomes three. Three becomes four… You’ve got TWO MINUTES to work your way up and successfully catch as many coasters as you possibly can. Highest successful coaster catch? YOUR NAME GOES ON THE BOARD. And then everyone else on the rooftop gets their chance to knock you off. 💰 $2 IN. WINNER TAKES ALL. Every attempt costs just $2, and every gold coin goes into the prize pool. We’re flipping from 5PM until 9PM. If your name is still sitting at the top of the board at 9PM? YOU TAKE THE LOT. 🎡 CAN’T CATCH A COASTER? YOU STILL GET A SPIN. Lightning reactions? Brilliant. Hands like concrete and you don't catch a thing? Also fine. Every $2 entry guarantees you a spin of the Aether chocolate wheel, with the chance to win complimentary middies, Aether merch, free spins, handshakes, high fives, maybe a packet of chips and whatever else the lads manage to find. 🏆 WIN FRIDAY. COME BACK SUNDAY. PLAY FOR $1,000. If you finish Friday night as our Coaster Flip champion, the cash isn't the end of it. You’ll also qualify for the Sweeney’s Beer Week Olympics Grand Final on Sunday. The weekly champions return to the rooftop for a sudden-death Cornhole Comp, with one enormous prize waiting for the last person standing: A $1,000 HOTEL SWEENEY’S BAR TAB. It’s Friday night. Drink beers nobody’s had before. Flip some coasters. Spin the wheel. Win some cash. Come back Sunday and have a crack at $1,000. What’s not to love? GET AMONGST IT. LET’S GO!

event_name: TWØBAYS: The Gluten-Free Rooftop Takeover | Beer Week Grand Final
date_text: Sun, Oct 25th • 12:00 PM AEDT - Sun, Oct 25th • 10:00 PM AEDT
description: THE FINAL DAY. 12 TAPS. 100% GLUTEN-FREE BEER. $1,000 ON THE LINE. LET’S FINISH SYDNEY BEER WEEK PROPERLY. For the final day of Sydney Beer Week, Hotel Sweeney’s is throwing open the rooftop taps to our mates from Melbourne — TWØBAYS Brewing Co. And when we say takeover, we mean it. 🍺 12 TAPS. 100% GLUTEN-FREE. That’s right — all 12 rooftop taps pouring gluten-free beer from TWØBAYS. Their last takeover at Sweeney’s saw kegs popping on the same day, and year after year this remains one of our most talked-about events — bringing together the gluten-free and coeliac community for something that can be pretty hard to find: A rooftop pub with an entire tap lineup of gluten-free beer. And this year, we’re going even bigger. With TWØBAYS opening their new Melbourne bar, we’ll have access to some of their exclusive taproom-only beers, making their way north to Sweeney’s especially for Sydney Beer Week. 🌞 ROOFTOP OPEN FROM 10AM Why wait until lunch? For the final day of Beer Week, we’re opening the Sweeney’s rooftop from 10AM, giving you plenty of time to grab a spot, work your way through the taps and settle in for the day. 🍽️ GLUTEN-FREE BEER. GLUTEN-FREE FOOD. The kitchen will be open with gluten-free meals available to order alongside your beers. Come hungry. Come thirsty. Make a day of it. 🏆 THE SWEENEY’S BEER WEEK OLYMPICS GRAND FINAL Then at 2PM, things get serious. After nine nights of ridiculous challenges, gold coins, chocolate wheels, questionable sporting ability and glorious victories, our nightly champions return to Hotel Sweeney’s for one final showdown. THE CORNHOLE GRAND FINAL. Nine nights. Nine winners. One sudden-death competition. One champion. And one enormous prize: A $1,000 HOTEL SWEENEY’S BAR TAB. Our finalists will need their beanbags ready and their finest wrist action dialled in, because when you’re out, you’re out. Last person standing takes the lot. 🌾 COELIAC? GLUTEN-FREE? OR JUST LOVE GREAT BEER? This is your day. TWØBAYS always brings an incredible crowd to Sweeney’s, and whether you’re coeliac, gluten-aware, bringing along someone who is, or simply keen to try some cracking Australian beer, everyone is welcome on the rooftop. Sydney Beer Week has given us nine massive nights. Now there’s only one thing left to do. Fill the taps. Fill the rooftop. Throw some beanbags. Crown a champion. 12 TAPS. 100% GLUTEN-FREE. $1,000 UP FOR GRABS. ONE LAST SUNDAY. LET’S GO!
